findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the plastic container holding disposable forks to be soiled with debris. The PIC was informed and immediately sent the container to the dish room for washing and sanitizing. Ensure these containers are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent an accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed that the trash can in the unisex bathroom did not have a lid. PIC was informed, and will replace the trash can with a lidded trash can. Ensure that toilet rooms used by females have covered receptacles for sanitary napkins for both hygienic purposes and to prevent plumbing issues from flushed feminine hygiene products.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build-up of soils on the ice machine baffle. Discussed with PIC. PIC immediately cleaned and sanitized baffle. Ensure baffle is cleaned enough to keep soil from accumulating.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a crack running the length of the underside of the larger chest freezer lid. Discussed with PIC. Ensure this area is repaired to be smooth, durable, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. 

A wiping cloth used for the counters in the prep area is observed stored on the counter. A discussion took place with the PIC and the cloth was moved to the sani bucket to correct. Ensure that in use wiping cloths are stored between uses in solution of effective concentration.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Gap showing daylight along the bottom of the back outside door was observed.  Gaps present in outside doors allow for easy entrance of pests and rodents.  Ensure the gap is sealed to protect facility against pest/weather entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Areas that require re-caulking/sealing:
-The hand sink
-Along the 3 part sink
Ensure these areas are caulked or sealed to create a smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable surface.


6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine baffle was observed to have mold.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure baffle is cleaned regularly to prevent contamination.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
The knife holder next to the 3 part sink was observed to contain an accumulation of dust and food debris.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the knife holder is cleaned regularly to prevent cross contamination.

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The fan located in the kitchen was observed to contain an accumulation of dust.  The dust on the front of the fan may blow around the food prep and cooking areas.  Ensure the fan is cleaned regularly to prevent contamination.

4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
